description: This file defines the AppDatabase class for managing an SQLite database used for storing notes in a Flutter application. It includes methods for initializing the database, querying, inserting, updating, and deleting note records with specific tables and indexes.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: A singleton-like class that manages the SQLite database for notes, including schema creation and CRUD operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database by opening/creating it and ensuring the schema is set up.

methods.name: queryNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes from the database, optionally filtered by search terms, ordered by pinned status and update time.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note record into the database and returns the new record ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its ID with new values.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note record by its ID.
